free_tier_limits.correction: Current API evaluation includes up to 15 Historic Time Series requests and 10 Live/Forecast requests at the user's locations, plus unlimited requests at designated unmetered locations. Separate hobbyist and researcher offers have their own eligibility and limits.

notes: Official sources were checked on 2026-08-11, and Solcast's status page reported the API operational. The example uses an undocumented legacy World API path; current documentation uses /data/live/radiation_and_weather. Rate limits are plan- and product-specific and visible in the Toolkit, with no universal public number. No official CORS policy was found.
